web.description:
# iHanna’s DIY Postcard Swap ### Would you like to send out some happy mail? The swap has grown to be a beloved feature of [my blog](https://www.ihanna.nu/), and many participate year after year. ![A collection of handmade postcards that I got through the years in the swap that is now well over 10 years](https://www.ihanna.nu/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/51077101596_5e98f76fa3_b.jpg) **DIY Postcard Swap [autumn 2026](https://www.ihanna.nu/postcard-swap/sign-up) open now!** ## The autumn 2026 Swap – open right now! Do not miss out. - After you’ve signed up I’d appreciate very much if you note the deadline (date of when the postcards should be ready to send) so you don’t forget - Have your ten handmade postcards ready to send out by the deadline date. A few days or so before that date you will receive your addresses via email from me personally – a time consuming task so be patient. And if you don’t see your addresses by the deadline you need to contact me so we can sort it out (after checking the spam folder). - Please make sure you read through the rules below and understand them before you sign up. I so appreciate your help with making this experience enjoyable for all of us, me included. Thank you! - Please make sure you have my e-mail address in your digital address-book. It’s hanna (at) ihanna dot nu - If you have any further questions after reading this page, check the FAQ – linked in menu above. ![iHanna Love!](http://www.ihanna.nu/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/pink-heart.png) _If you would like to be notified about the next swap, make sure that you are subscribed to [the newsletter](https://www.ihanna.nu/newsletter)._ _Thank you._ ## Dates and deadline for AUTUMN 2026 | | | |-|-| | Sign up by (last day to sign up / join) is | Nov 2, 2026 | **DIY Postcard Swap [autumn 2026](https://www.ihanna.nu/postcard-swap/sign-up) open now!** # The DIY Postcard Swap Rules | | | |-|-| | #### 1. Join the swap by paying the 8.50 dollar fee | This swap is growing every year and I love that, one year there were way over 200 participants! This fee is for participating with 10 handmade postcards but a 20 postcard option is also available. To be able to take _the time_ to arrange it, I need to charge a small fee. To pay is easy, quick and secure. Once you click the sign up-button above, you will be taken to the sign-up page. There your payment goes through the well-known site of **Paypal**. You can participate without a paypal account: then you pay with a credit card. Just click the paypal button and instead of logging in, choose card payment at the bottom of the page. | | #### 3. Make 10 handmade postcards | You will make 10 postcards (or 20 if you are feeling very productive). Your choice of postcard size and style. Just remember no copies – just original art. We do not accept AI generated anything! Bought postcards are beautiful – but those are not a choice in this swap. Instead try to be artistic with your handmade postcards, and have fun while making them. Make sure your “hand” is detected easily.
DIY actually means “Do It Yourself”, and you can experiment with what you’ve got at home. Try collage, mixed media, create flat fabric art, alter an existing postcard from your paper stash (!), paint with watercolors or acrylics, draw a mandala, make a scrapbook style card, embellish, sew, paint, embroider, and so on! I’ve got plenty of blog posts with [postcard inspiration](https://www.ihanna.nu/postcard-swap/#inspirations), all listed below. | | #### 5. Some Optional Ideas | Detail on the optional ideas below, but just quickly: Invite your friends to be in the swap! Help spread the word by sharing the link button on instagram or any other social media you’re using. Host a postcard party! Document your process in photos, video, make a instagram reel or a blog post! Share your postcards online! Blog about them before the deadline to give your own followers a chance to join. Comment on other’s images and be encouraging and kind.
Use the hashtag **#ihannaspostcardswap** on social media. Follow [this bluesky feed](https://bsky.app/profile/ihannas.bsky.social/feed/diypostcardswap). | ## Benefits of joining the Swap **DIY Postcard Swap [autumn 2026](https://www.ihanna.nu/postcard-swap/sign-up) open now!**
